title: Not a strong magnetic , weak like my wood one.
text:
Not a strong magnetic , weak like my wood one.. I have a strong magnetic stainless knife bar hanging on my kitchen wall for about 15 yrs.
Then I bought more knifes , And bought a wood knife magnet that was not strong for
normal everyday chef knifes.
When I saw this medal magnet I figured all the stainless magnetic bars where the same, ( that is Not so) and
This was a good price compared to my other stainless magnetic. But now I understand why this seller is showing the knifes Hanging down, which is very dangerous, and has heavy handle on the top!
Cause this magnetic knife bar is Very Weak if you have normal to heavy chef knifes this will
Cause them to slip down when you grab the handle. Very dangerous.

Also the magnetic bar here shows very light type of kitchen utensils hanging
On the bar.

For me this is a waste of money and dangerous to have a weak knife magnet bar on a wall,
and the time it took my hubby to hang this.

Hang your knifes with the handles at the bottom, and knife tip on top.

One star.

product_metadata.title: 10 IN Stainless Steel Magnetic Knife Holder, Knife Rack/Bar for Wall, Refrigerator, Heavy-Duty Knife Bar with Powerful Magnetic Pull Force
features: 【Extra Strong Hold】This stainless steel magnetic bar comes with heavy-duty magnets for securing it to a wall, without any slipping or shifting. High-grade stainless steel we chose is built to last long.

【Kitchen Assistant】10 inches long, it has plenty of space for any set of knives. It can hold up to 5 knives or tools and gives you enough clearance from the wall to prevent you from injuring your hands when grabbing one.

【Protect Your Knives】Our wall-mounted magnetic knife holder not only grants you extra counter or drawer space, but it also prevents knives from scratching against surfaces and each other, keeping edges sharp.
【Widely Applicable】This can also be used in the office or garage to hang scissors, screwdrivers, and other metal tools.

【Magnetic or screw-in mounting】This comes with all the mounting hardware required for screwed-in mounting. Because this mounts with a magnet, it can be attached to a refrigerator or other metal surface.
